findings_and_questions.kind: conditional source-order question linked to prior 059
findings_and_questions.first_contract: The building openings composition queues door work before calling spawn_building_windows. Window compilation returns its whole vector, but the subsequent loop converts one window at a time and queues each successful spawn before converting the next. The observer inserts its parent collider only after opening spawning succeeds. A late fallible window conversion or later caller failure can thus occur after earlier commands have been queued, with no compensating cleanup in the inspected bodies.
findings_and_questions.condition: A late conversion/collider failure must be reachable after earlier queued work, and Bevy’s actual deferred command/error application and any external cleanup must permit it. Individually finite coordinates can overflow in the datum subtraction and be rejected, but normal generator/scene bounds were not established. No leaked entity or runtime execution is claimed.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: Determine the product owner’s all-or-nothing or partial-recovery contract and actual command application semantics. If atomicity is required, plan fallible conversions and parent/child ownership before queueing while preserving typed first causes and intentional failure diagnostics.
relationships: 059 Q-L12-0ac6b5205d33d354e784 already leaves native queued intents and failed observer/door partial publication open; current window ordering and caller source sharpen it, not an automatic new unique count.
Different from prior P16-WINDOW-LEAF-UNBOUNDED-WORK and tiny shutter render errors; central reconciliation determines shared lifecycle ownership.

findings_and_questions.kind: prior aggregate question, not a unique finding
findings_and_questions.first_contract: Window and door conversions admit the rotated quaternion and separately convert position, hinge, directions and yaw while preserving typed size, relative open angle, identity and optional bar mode. Public individually checked WindowSpec and DoorSpec fields do not themselves establish that hinge, centre, direction, yaw and swing form a coherent aggregate. The inspected server consumers use the converted hinge and native rotation.
findings_and_questions.condition: An independently constructed or decoded incoherent leaf must reach a consumer relying on these relationships. Normal generator invariants, every native frame boundary and allowed alternative hinges remain unproven; independent fields alone do not prove a gameplay defect.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: Establish the actual upstream invariant owner and frame-specific swing contract before imposing validation; preserve changed-frame operations and typed error/identity behavior.
relationships: Related to previous /root/mhr_character P16-DOORSPEC-CROSS-FIELD-POLICY and P16-WINDOWSPEC-AGGREGATE, and to 059 L12-CLOSURE-SCENE-WINDOW-NATIVE-PROJECTION-LIGHTING; no automatic alias or duplicated count.

findings_and_questions.kind: revision difference and qualified authority question
findings_and_questions.first_contract: P16 exposed GateDatum’s SupportElevation tuple member publicly. Current 95e makes it private and adds new/elevation methods; from_metres delegates to new. The current distant-boundary producer passes an already typed support elevation directly to new, while the server boundary observer reconstructs a datum from the entity transform Y. The inspected generated server spawn initializes that transform Y from boundary elevation.
findings_and_questions.condition: Whether a later update can make these two sources disagree, or whether they intentionally serve different scenes, was not traced. A private-field API change is not by itself a behavior defect, stale state proof or compatibility requirement.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: Keep the checked support elevation owner and actual authoritative scene handoff distinct; trace mutation/lifetime policy before accepting a duplicated-source finding.

findings_and_questions.kind: bounded nonfinding and historical producer link
findings_and_questions.first_contract: SceneDoorPose and SceneWindowPose privately retain the converted typed leaf with its native quaternion; accessor returns a leaf copy. The inspected server consumers and review viewer obtain leaf and native rotation from the same pose without mutating the copy before use. The native product preserves the original order rather than reconstructing a quaternion from the summed yaw.
findings_and_questions.condition: This does not prove every other caller respects the pairing or that arbitrary initially inconsistent public leaf fields become valid. Existing tests read as source were not executed.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: Preserve paired conversion, native multiplication order, and checked frame transitions when reconciling consumers.
relationships: 059 L12-CLOSURE-SCENE-DOOR-PAIRED-POSE-AUTHORITY asks whether another consumer mutates a copy, and L12-CLOSURE-SCENE-WINDOW-NATIVE-PROJECTION-LIGHTING leaves other consumers open.
774 rig F003 separately identifies checked hinge/open angle converted into retained raw controllers/reviewer fields, not a defect in the private pairing itself.

findings_and_questions.kind: qualified nonfinding and open numerical limits
findings_and_questions.first_contract: CollisionCentreDatum validates orientation, then converts point/direction/quaternion outputs through frame-specific checked owners and maps window/door errors to the original opening and source. PlanDirection and RigidRotation enforce normalized native values rather than silently normalizing them; Radians enforces finite values.
findings_and_questions.condition: Finite input values alone do not prove finite output after subtraction/addition or that rounded native rotations satisfy every checked tolerance. The actual Bevy numeric implementation, generated bounds and extreme input policies remain open; no blanket valid-input failure or render incident is established.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: Maintain first-cause identities, frame and operation ordering, and define any required supported numerical domain at the owner rather than silently altering arithmetic.
relationships: Historical 059 READ-L12-857/858 personally covered limited P16 conversion scopes only; this is an independent current read and not whole-family validation.

nonfindings: Current GateDatum encapsulation does not by itself show changed mathematical behavior or a compatibility requirement.
Private native leaf/rotation pairing is a bounded source property; no actual consumer desynchronization was found in inspected windows.
Fallible numerical re-admission and contextual errors do not by themselves establish a bad generated geometry incident.
Test source and previous reviewer results do not constitute runtime validation.
